2609.24554.title: Toward a Unified Mathematics of Concepts
2609.24554.paper_summary: Concepts are commonly defined as abstract, compact representations of knowledge and treated as basic units of intelligent behavior. Yet, cognition, psychology, and AI lack a shared mathematical language for them. Modern systems represent concepts as vectors, distributions, symbols, graphs, and other structures, but these formalisms are typically treated as competing rather than as solutions to a common problem. We propose an operation-based view that evaluates mathematical frameworks by the conceptual operations they support, identifying thirteen operations (including similarity, composition, generalization, and grounding) that recur across cognition, psychology, and AI. We show that ten frameworks embody distinct commitments to concepts as self-contained content, relational structure, or evolving process, and that these commitments determine which operations each supports naturally. For example, vector-based models facilitate graded similarity and generalization but struggle with explicit composition, whereas symbolic models support composition but offer but generalize poorly. No single framework we examined naturally supports all operations without extension. We test this account empirically using categorization as a case study, operationalizing nine theories on the same items against human judgments. Despite addressing the same conceptual question, the theories produce different procedures and results, demonstrating that mathematical commitment shapes what a theory can explain. We call for hybrid formalisms that treat content, relation, and process as jointly primary.
2609.24554.paper_summary_zh: 概念通常被定義為知識的抽象、緊湊表示，並被視為智慧行為的基本單位。<lb/>然而，認知、心理學和人工智慧缺乏一種共享的數學語言來描述它們。<lb/>現代系統將概念表示為向量、分佈、符號、圖形和其他結構，但這些形式主義通常被視為競爭的，而不是作為共同問題的解決方案。<lb/>我們提出了一種基於運算的觀點，通過它們所支持的概念運算來評估數學框架，識別出在認知、心理學和人工智慧中重複出現的十三種運算（包括相似性、組合、概括和基礎）。<lb/>我們顯示出十個框架體現了對於概念作為自足內容、關係結構或演變過程的不同承諾，而這些承諾決定了每個框架自然支持哪些運算。<lb/>例如，基於向量的模型促進了漸進相似性和概括，但在明確的組合上表現不佳，而符號模型支持組合但在概括上表現不佳。<lb/>我們檢查的沒有一個框架自然支持所有運算而不需要擴展。<lb/>我們通過將分類作為案例研究來實證測試這一觀點，將九種理論在相同項目上與人類判斷進行操作化比較。<lb/>儘管這些理論解決的是相同的概念問題，但產生了不同的程序和結果，顯示出數學承諾塑造了理論能解釋的內容。<lb/>我們呼籲混合形式主義，將內容、關係和過程視為共同的主要元素。
